cases.name: Jordan Elizabeth Smith Diggins
cases.about: Her obituary said, "She was a gentle and sweet soul and a truly beautiful and beloved daughter, sister, mother, wife, niece, friend, and co-worker. She was a delightful student and friend to many at Lee Hill Elementary, Thornburg Middle, and Massaponax High schools. She graduated from Ferrum College with a social work degree and soon after dedicated her time to working as a therapeutic foster care giver in the Richmond area.  She then devoted herself to helping infants, toddlers and their families for the Rappahannock Area Community Service Board – families that will no-doubt greatly grieve her sudden loss."
